title: Plan
description: The tasks of each approved plan, indexed when its plan gate is applied, and the record kept when its run's ledger is imported. Only nexus commands write it.

plans.description: One entry per approved plan, oldest first. A phase's current plan is its newest entry.

phase.description: The phase the plan belongs to.

gate.description: The plan gate that approved it.

document.description: The plan document, relative to the build folder.

title.description: The document's first # heading, or its file name.

tasks.description: The plan's `### Task <N>: <title>` headings, in document order.

number.description: The plan's task number; only joins ledger lines, never shown.

title.description: How the task is named everywhere a person reads.

record.description: Kept by `nexus ledger import`: each task's outcome when the run's ledger was imported. Null until then.

findings.description: What the round's findings were, as the ledger says.

imported.description: When `nexus ledger import` kept this record.

ledger.description: The ledger it was imported from: relative to the repo root, or absolute when it sits outside it.

tasks.description: Each plan task's outcome, by task ID.

state.description: `done` once the ledger has the task's completion line.

commits.description: The commit range on the completion line.

note.description: The note on the task's completion line, such as its test command or review result.

parked.description: How many findings were parked for later.

fixRounds.description: Each fix round the task's review needed.

rulings.description: Rulings made in the final review.

minors.description: Minor findings the final review deferred.
